checkpoint_rule: fixed final3passes; source-only pass1 learning curve, no target selection
teacher: Frozen C01 pretrained_none seed348; same own-history innovation teacher in all arms; its original detector correction is discarded
input_boundary: Observations-derived local innovations, valid, normal DAG, frozen original TimeRCD base logit. No true roots/event windows/lag/coefficients/noise or normal twin as inference inputs
C1: Exact common-multi TimeRCD logit; no C1 optimizer; not a uni checkpoint comparison
target: Fixed existing100development only; no target optimizer or validation/locked access
primary: Source-system and development-system paired AP/VUS/FPR and conditional/end-to-end event-matched RCA, graph x root loss interaction
stop: Fixed3passes or technical deadline; no extension based on CE or target scores; all arms evaluated, no auto expansion
support: Root improvement must transfer to AP/VUS against same-logit base and calibration controls, replicated over3seeds; report bootstrap and every decline. Root-only gain is RCA-only evidence
compute_control: Same parameterization and all dense C2 messages/Linear slots in every arm. Zero-value and empty-graph arms have lower active information/effective capacity; do not claim fully matched effective capacity. Additional root-loss computation separately counted
